items.requirement_text: How much RAM does a standard issue desktop computer have?

candidate_snippets.snippet: Office IT Equipment Reference Sheet A simple reference sheet describing common office IT equipment, intended for new employee onboarding. Desktop Computers Standard issue desktop computers run a quad-core processor with 16 GB of RAM and a 512 GB solid-state drive. They come pre-installed with the company's standard office suite and are replaced on a 4-year refresh cycle. Laptops Laptops are issued to employees who travel or work remotely more than twice a week. The standard laptop model has a 14-inch display, 16 GB RAM, and a battery life of approximately 10 hours under normal use. Monitors Employees at a fixed desk are issued one 24-inch monitor by default. A second monitor can be requested through the IT portal and requires manager approval. Office Printers Each floor has one shared network printer capable of double-sided printing and stapling. Print jobs over 50 pages require a print-release code, issued automatically by email. Wi-Fi Access The office provides two wireless networks: a main employee network requiring single sign-on, and a guest network that expires after 24 hours and does not require a company account. Headsets Noise-cancelling headsets are issued to employees who take more than five calls per week on average. Replacement headsets can be requested once per year without additional approval. Badge Access Employee badges grant access to the building between 7 AM and 9 PM on weekdays. Weekend access requires a separate request submitted at least 24 hours in advance. Loaner Equipment A small pool of loaner laptops and chargers is available at the front desk for employees whose equipment is being repaired. Loaner equipment must be returned within 5 business days.
